raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner initially misinterpreted the intended boundary in the puzzle. The puzzle requires identifying the nation that lies geographically between the host of the 2020 AFC U-23 Championship qualification (Thailand) and the nation containing A Don (Russia). The Planner correctly identified Myanmar as the boundary nation but incorrectly concluded that teak was the predominant wood produced during British rule in Myanmar. While teak was a significant export, gurjan (Dipterocarpus) was actually the most produced by volume during the colonial period. This misunderstanding of the term "mostly produced" led to the wrong solution being pursued.
